item.title: Version 1.3
item.description: - **Ask AI can now read the repository.** It can search files, inspect relevant code and commits, and show what it looked at instead of guessing from a short activity summary. Supported Macs can use Apple’s larger Private Cloud Compute model; otherwise it stays on-device. - **Switch branches without leaving Gitmunk.** Use the branch picker or ⌘B to switch local branches, check out remote branches, or jump to a linked worktree. - **Diverged branches now have a way forward.** Untangle compares both paths, previews conflicts, preserves uncommitted work, and can create an optional protected backup before merging. - **Change counts keep up with new folders.** Files inside newly created directories are counted individually, and filesystem updates are handled more reliably. - **New files show real diffs.** Untracked files display their added contents instead of an empty or confusing “No diff” view. - **The interface is a little calmer.** Repository actions and the top sidebar entries now use clean, text-only labels.

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description:
- **Pull more than one repository at a time.** Start a pull, switch repositories, and start another without waiting. Each repository shows its own progress, while Pull All safely skips work already underway. - **Merged branch cleanup handles stale upstreams correctly.** When a local branch is fully merged into your default branch but ahead of its tracking branch, Gitmunk now verifies it against the default branch and cleans it up safely.
_And everything introduced in 1.2.0:_
- **Repository views are persistent and faster.** Gitmunk stores repository state and Recent Commits locally, making reopening the app and switching repositories faster and more stable. - **Rename repositories locally.** Give a repository a custom display name without changing its folder or GitHub name. - **Protect important branches.** Lock branches to keep them out of **Safe to clean up** and visible under **Active + Protected**. - **Repository pages stay steady.** Switching repositories no longer flashes or unnecessarily reloads Recent Commits. - **Refreshes are more reliable.** Local and remote histories merge cleanly, and refreshes target only affected repositories. - **History changes are detected precisely.** Rebases, force pushes, and amended commits invalidate cached feeds correctly. - **Commit titles are clickable.** Dashboard commit rows expand from either the title or surrounding row. - **Preferences survive GitHub renames.** Local names, protected branches, and other preferences follow renamed repositories.

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description:
• **Repository views are persistent and faster.** Gitmunk now stores repository state and Recent Commits locally, so reopening the app or switching repositories is faster and more stable. Cached feeds refresh only when the underlying Git history changes.
  • **Rename repositories locally.** Give a repository a custom display name from the sidebar, then reset it whenever you like without changing its folder or GitHub name.
  • **Protect important branches.** Use the new lock controls to exclude branches from **Safe to clean up** and keep them visible under **Active + Protected**.
  • **Repository pages stay steady.** Switching repositories no longer flashes or unnecessarily reloads Recent Commits, and loading older commits is now an explicit action.
  • **Refreshes are more reliable.** Local and remote commit feeds merge cleanly, filesystem refreshes target only affected repositories, and every refresh indicator stays synchronized through the complete refresh.
  • **History changes are detected precisely.** Rebases, force pushes, and amended commits now invalidate cached feeds correctly.
  • **Commit titles are clickable.** Dashboard commit rows now expand when you click either the title or the surrounding row.
  • **Preferences survive GitHub renames.** Local names, protected branches, and other repository preferences follow the repository when its GitHub name changes.

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description: • **Tagged commits now show their tags.** If a commit is tagged — like a release (`v1.1.1`) — that tag now appears as a small badge right on the commit row, in both the dashboard and the repo view.

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
• **Fixed the freeze-after-close.** Leaving Gitmunk running with its window closed could, given enough time and activity, wedge it completely — the dock icon wouldn't bring it back and only a force-quit did. That's fixed.
  • **Sidebar stays put on reopen.** Reopening the window after it had been closed for a while could briefly scramble your sidebar order for a few seconds while it re-synced. It holds its place now.
  • **Refreshing is instant now.** Your repos and their commit counts update from local state immediately, while GitHub syncs in the background — no more waiting on the network.
  • **The dashboard shows what you'll actually pull** — the incoming commits themselves, not just a number.
  • **Opening a repo is faster.** Recent commits appear right away, and revisiting a repo you've already opened no longer reloads or gets stuck on "Loading…".
  • **New Branches tab.** See which branches need attention and catch them up to their remote (fast-forward) without checking them out — plus clean up branches already merged into your default, with a note on why they're safe to remove.
  • **Redesigned repo view** — Files / Branches / PRs tabs with a cleaner, card-based layout.
  • **Multiple GitHub accounts** now work — repos across different signed-in `gh` accounts resolve and load correctly.
